items.title:
net.oneandone.ioc-unit:ioc-unit-bom 5.0.0 发布, Bill of Materials for ioc-unit. Import this pom (scope=import) in a consumer's
        dependencyManagement to pin every ioc-unit artifact to a single, consistent version
        without pinning versions of the WildFly/Jakarta APIs that ioc-unit itself only
        requires as "provided". Those must keep coming from the consumer's own WildFly BOM
        (org.wildfly.bom:wildfly-ee-with-tools / wildfly-expansion-with-tools) so no
        duplicate/conflicting Jakarta or Hibernate versions end up on the classpath. Likewise,

        (system properties over environment over properties file), model builders serializing
        to the API contract, an HTTP client with token auth, retries and timeouts,
        run-selection modes, and an Allure-compatible file sink. No runtime dependencies:
        HTTP via java.net.http (JDK 11+), JSON via a small built-in codec, so any
        test-framework adapter can build on top of it.
